mentions.name: Workstamp
mentions.description: Time tracking app and control panel for companies, built to comply with Spanish law and now released as a SaaS product with explicit company registration and an entry-level barrier to reduce for broader SaaS use.
mentions.problem: Built out of frustration with existing tools, since companies need basic time tracking for compliance with Spanish law.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a time tracking app and control panel for ourselves at our company out of frustration (it was very basic, for compliance with spanish law) and eventually we just fixed so much stuff and added so many features that we just released it as a product https://workstamp.eu
